name: Meshullam (Simeonite)
title: Head of the tribe of Simeon
summary: Meshullam was one of the heads of the tribe of Simeon, mentioned in the genealogy among the families that grew and sought new land during King Hezekiah's time.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of Simeon
keyEvents.description: Meshullam is listed among the heads of the tribe of Simeon.
